grid: floor((x-origin_x)/scale), floor((y-origin_y)/scale); lower closed upper open
sampling_population: occupied blocks only, conditional on event-bearing blocks; empty blocks not sampled
estimator: sum paired event differences in sampled blocks / sum event counts in sampled blocks; repeated blocks repeat all events
interval: marginal 95% percentile; quantile linear; no multiplicity adjustment
scale_rationale: predeclared 1/2/5 km grids examine increasing clustering scales; not estimated decorrelation lengths or validated optimal blocks
